{{Hatnote|1=Transcript of an episode of ''The Booster Pack'' podcast. Part 1 of the interview covers the ''Star Trek'' CCG.}}
'''The Booster Pack #28: The making of the Star Wars CCG with Tom Braunlich''' (24 August 2022) is the second half of a two-part interview in which SWCCG co-designer [[Tom Braunlich]] describes developing the game in 1995: the design retreat with [[Rollie Tesh]] at [[Richard Borg]]'s house, the deck-as-Force concept, the light and dark sides and destiny numbers, mining the films and Skywalker Ranch's prop department for cards, nightly card-review sessions with [[Warren Holland]] and [[Jerry Darcy]], the first World Championship in Vail, ''[[Young Jedi]]'', and a planned Harry Potter CCG. Participants: Rands (host, CCG History), [[Tom Braunlich]].

Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXdIdJwnjgc THE BOOSTER PACK #28 — The making of the STAR WARS CCG with Tom Braunlich || Decipher || TCG SWCCG], The Booster Pack Network, YouTube (uploaded 24 August 2022). Part 1: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zK_94pNOPTU THE BOOSTER PACK #27 — The making of the STAR TREK CCG with Tom Braunlich].

''The text below is from the video's automatic captions, corrected for names and card titles; it has not yet been checked against the audio. Sponsor and subscription announcements at the end are left out. Words that could not be made out are marked [unclear].''
